svg.title: pbc --help
svg.text: pbc --help
$ pbc --help
PB-Compiler - PowerBASIC 3.5 compatible compiler for 16-bit real-mode DOS
Usage: pbc [options] <source.BAS>
pbc lib build <out.PBL|out.LIB> <unit.PBU>...
pbc lib list <file.PBL|file.PBU>
A source with $COMPILE UNIT produces a .PBU unit instead of an EXE;
$LINK "X.PBU" / $LINK "Y.PBL" directives (relative to the source
directory) are linked into the executable.
Options:
-O <file> output file name (default: <source>.EXE / .PBU)
-I <dir> additional $INCLUDE search directory
--dialect <d> language level: tb1x|pb2x..pb35 (default)|pb36 (optimizer)|qb1x..qb45|pds7x
-G386 allow 80386 instructions (PBC.EXE compatibility)
-OZF prefer SPEED; enables size-for-speed and relaxed-FP transforms when optimizing
--optimize enable the optimizer for any dialect
--no-optimize disable optimization even for pb36 / $OPTIMIZE SPEED
--parallel-loops opt in to O0311 for hosted C/LLVM; link runtime/pbc_parallel.c with OpenMP
--dump-tokens stop after lexing/preprocessing and list tokens
--dump-ast stop after parsing
--dump-bind stop after semantic analysis
--emit-obj compile to a linkable OMF .OBJ object instead of an EXE
--emit-basic un-parse the bound (optimized) tree back to readable PowerBASIC
--emit-llvm optimize through the IR middle end and emit textual LLVM
--emit-c optimize through the IR middle end and emit portable C99
--x-backend compile through the IR and native x86-16 back end (the default)
--no-x-backend compile through the legacy direct emitter instead (PBC_X_BACKEND=0)
--x-backend-strict route everything: a body the back end declines is an error, not a fallback
--list write a human-readable .LST map of the compiled image
-h, --help show this help
